title: Job Pleads with God

questions.question: What does Job loathe?
questions.explanation: Job 10:1 (ESV): "I loathe my life; I will give free utterance to my complaint..."

questions.question: What does Job ask God not to do?
questions.explanation: Job 10:2 (ESV): "I will say to God, Do not condemn me; let me know why you contend against me."

questions.question: How does Job describe God's hands?
questions.explanation: Job 10:8 (ESV): "Your hands fashioned and made me, and now you have destroyed me altogether."

questions.question: God granted Job life and what else?
questions.explanation: Job 10:12 (ESV): "You have granted me life and steadfast love, and your care has preserved my spirit."

questions.question: If Job is wicked, what then?
questions.explanation: Job 10:15 (ESV): "If I am wicked, woe to me! If I am righteous, I cannot lift up my head..."

questions.question: Did you not pour me out like what?
questions.explanation: Job 10:10 (ESV): "Did you not pour me out like milk and curdle me like cheese?"

questions.question: You clothed me with what?
questions.explanation: Job 10:11 (ESV): "You clothed me with skin and flesh, and knit me together with bones and sinews."

questions.question: Does God have eyes of what?
questions.explanation: Job 10:4 (ESV): "Have you eyes of flesh? Do you see as man sees?"

questions.question: If I lift myself up, you hunt me like a what?
questions.explanation: Job 10:16 (ESV): "And were my head lifted up, you would hunt me like a lion..."

questions.question: Are not my days what?
questions.explanation: Job 10:20 (ESV): "Are not my days few? Then cease, and leave me alone..."

questions.question: Where will Job go before he does not return?
options: To the land of darkness and deep shadow
questions.correctAnswer: To the land of darkness and deep shadow
questions.explanation: Job 10:21 (ESV): "before I go whence I shall not return, to the land of darkness and deep shadow,"

questions.question: Where even the light is as what?
questions.explanation: Job 10:22 (ESV): "the land of gloom like thick darkness, like deep shadow without any order, where light is as thick darkness."

questions.question: You renew your what against me?
questions.explanation: Job 10:17 (ESV): "You renew your witnesses against me and increase your vexation toward me..."

questions.question: Why did Job wish he had been carried from the womb to the tomb?
options: So no eye would have seen him
questions.correctAnswer: So no eye would have seen him
questions.explanation: Job 10:18–19 (ESV): "...would that I had died before any eye had seen me..."

key_verse_text: You have granted me life and steadfast love, and your care has preserved my spirit.
